title: Emails for Manor PD and LexisNexis

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting emails between the Manor and LexisNexis Risk Solutions, and emails concerning LexisNexis Risk Solutions.

1) Domains: all emails between your agency and "@lexisnexis.com", "@lexisnexisrisk.com", or "@lnssi.com". Timeframe: October 1, 2026 through November 20, 2026.

2) Keywords: all emails containing "LexisNexis", "AVCC", "Accurint Virtual Crime Center", or "Lexis Nexis" in the subject or body. Timeframe: October 1, 2026 through November 20, 2026. We recommend searching "Accurint Virtual Crime Center" as a quoted phrase rather than as separate words, so the results do not include every email containing "crime" or "center."

Include: emails, attachments, inline and embedded images, links, and the subject and to/from/cc lines. Please provide the original emails in full.
Format: if possible, please provide the original electronic files (.eml, .msg, .mbox, .pst, or a similar native format) so the integrity of the original messages is preserved. If native files are not available, a PDF export is acceptable.
If any emails are withheld in whole or in part, please include a list of what was withheld and cite the specific exemption relied on for each.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal

To Whom It May Concern:

Shawn Segal

title: ALPR Audit and Data - Itasca Co. Sheriff's Office

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting the following records about the Itasca County Sheriff's Office's use of automated license plate readers (ALPRs), including Flock Safety cameras:

1. Any independent biennial audit of the agency's ALPR data arranged under Minn. Stat. 13.824, subd. 6, and any audit summary report sent to the commissioner of administration or the Legislative Commission on Data Practices and Personal Data Privacy. If no audit was ever arranged or completed, a written statement saying so is sufficient.

2. The agreement or agreements with Flock Safety for ALPR cameras, including order forms and renewals, and the 2026 notice or correspondence canceling or terminating those agreements.

3. The agency's notification to the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension of its ALPR installation or use under Minn. Stat. 13.824, subd. 8.

I am trying to establish the dates the county operated ALPRs and whether the required audit was done. Time range: January 1, 2019 through the date of fulfillment. Please send electronic copies by email.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
